[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/reference-architecture.md#template-usage-instructions]

## Template Usage Instructions

1. **Copy this template** to create a new reference architecture document
2. **Replace all bracketed placeholders** with actual content
3. **Remove template instructions** before publishing
4. **Follow the directory and naming convention**:
    - Directory: `strategy/reference/[domain]/[architecture-type]/`
    - Filename: `[domain]-[architecture-type]-reference-architecture.md`
    - Reference Architecture ID: `REF-[CATEGORY]-[TYPE]-[NNN]`
    - Example: `strategy/reference/enterprise/microservices/enterprise-microservices-reference-architecture.md`
5. **Generate a unique reference architecture ID** following the convention: `REF-{CATEGORY}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
6. **Complete all required sections** before submitting for review
7. **Include appropriate diagrams** and architectural specifications
8. **Validate against quality checklist** before submission

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] All metadata fields completed
- [ ] Executive summary clearly states purpose and business value
- [ ] Architecture vision and objectives are well-defined
- [ ] Context and constraints are thoroughly documented
- [ ] All architecture views are present with appropriate detail
- [ ] Component specifications are complete and implementable
- [ ] Implementation guidelines are actionable and comprehensive
- [ ] Deployment and operations considerations are addressed
- [ ] Governance and compliance requirements are specified
- [ ] Examples and use cases demonstrate practical application
- [ ] Related architectures and references are accurate and relevant
- [ ] Change history section is complete with initial entry
- [ ] Review log section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] Document follows markdown formatting standards
- [ ] Architecture diagrams are clear, consistent, and well-labeled
- [ ] Content is technically accurate and architecturally sound
- [ ] Reference architecture has been reviewed by relevant stakeholders
